In addition to releasing the public beta 2 of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is also simultaneously rolling out the first Release Candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2.

Older versions of macOS continue to receive security updates

As is the usual practice when Apple releases minor updates for older versions of macOS, the company did not publish a regular beta before rolling out the first Release Candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 later last month, with both versions having gone through two Release Candidates before their official rollout.

The release notes published by Apple for the first Release Candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only state that the relevant versions "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users to install." Apple is expected to announce the details of the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 after their official release, which is anticipated to be within the next few weeks alongside the release of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

The build number for Release Candidate 1 of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 is 24H219, while the build number for Release Candidate 1 of macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 is 25G320.

Have you discovered any new features or differences in this Release Candidate? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
